## Rows

- 108 (#33048 · 6846028996), `automation.flow-reference-package-resolution`: the remedy 'Declare a dependency…' reads wrong when the holder is the environment.
- 130 (#33048), `studio-authoring.access-permission-set-lifecycle`: the ITEM_LOCKED sentence says 'Clone', but Studio labels the action 'New similar'.
- 164 (#33058 · 6846283471), `cli.flag-command-error-ux`: an unknown subcommand at topic level prints no `--help` pointer.
- 233 (#33092 · 6850793622): `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` says FORBIDDEN where a non-reader gets 404.

## Do
Fix each sentence where it is produced. Update a checklist item only if its clause quotes the old text.

## Grade

## Reader
